Per attach: one MAX(seq) read, then ceil(rows behind / 1,000) page reads (REPLAY_PAGE_ROWS = 1,000), each a rowid seek (SEARCH spine_events USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid>?)) costing its 1,000 rows; the first page is read before the Hello, each later one only after the client took the last; at most one page (~0.4 MB at ~370 B a row) in memory; a disconnect stops within the page in flight. No loop, timer, poll or launch site added; scales with attaches x rows behind, not with seats or ticks.
